fields.acceptance: ship-change-one-ci.txtar passes with go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/ship-change-one-ci$', its fake claude in the built-in ship-change's conduct step recording each plan, code and qa round with an evidence line for the leaf first; (failure case) the script asserts that a clean round without evidence for first, recorded by hand in the conduct step before the covered round, fails with stderr naming the uncovered leaf first.
fields.must_not: Change Go code; drop or weaken an existing assertion of a script; touch scripts of classic checks steps or plan review.
fields.statement: The cmd/rhiza testscripts whose fake conductor checks record rounds with rhiza run findings --check in a conductor step pass an evidence line for every leaf their round does not name in a finding, so they pass under the leaf-coverage refusal.
